Title: Send default notification template
Preconditions: Admin signed in at {{BACK_URL}} with notification management permissions; VirtoCommerce.Notifications module installed and active; notification type 'OrderCreateEmailNotification' has a template for the default language; outbound mail transport configured for the environment
Steps:
[NAV] {{BACK_URL}}/#!/workspace/notifications
[WAIT] Notifications list blade loaded
[GRID] search the list for 'OrderCreateEmailNotification'
[ACT] click the row matching 'OrderCreateEmailNotification'
[WAIT] the '...: Details' blade opens with the Templates grid
[ACT] click the template row for the default language
[WAIT] the '...: Template' blade opens
[ACT] click 'Send test email' in the blade toolbar
[WAIT] the recipient prompt is shown
[ACT] fill 'Email': {{ADMIN_EMAIL}}
[ACT] click 'Send'
[WAIT] a notification about the send result appears
Assertions:
[DOM] 'Send test email' in the blade toolbar is enabled while the template body is non-empty
[TOAST] a notification reports the send was accepted and no error dialog is present
[BLADE] the '...: Template' blade is still open after the send
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] the send request returns 2xx with no 4xx/5xx
[EMAIL] exactly one test message arrives at {{ADMIN_EMAIL}} within 60s (BL-NOTIF-001)
[CONSOLE] no JS errors in the Admin SPA during the send
Failure_Signals: 'Send test email' disabled on a valid template; red 5xx toast on send; spinner visible >5s; zero or duplicate test messages received
Cleanup: Close the Template and Details blades with the blade close control without saving; template content left unmodified
